title: EPUB headings may be outside default translation selection
symptom: The EPUB route defaults to translating p elements; a book that embeds prose or headings in other HTML tags needs an explicit selection or planning step.
user_impact: Certain book elements can be left untranslated if the input HTML structure differs from the default.

steps: Use --translate-tags h1,h2,h3,p,div as appropriate, or review the EPUB planning selection before a full run.

remaining_question: How frequently do actual permitted EPUBs contain substantive text outside recognized tags?
verification_plan: Use small licensed EPUB fixtures with h1-h3, p and nested divs; compare source and translated segment coverage.
